summary: Scully Royalty Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to report a change of auditor, disclosing that AOGB CPA Limited resigned on March 11, 2026, and the board approved the engagement of EliteCPA P.C. as the successor independent registered public accounting firm effective July 14, 2026, for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure required under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. No deal terms, premiums, or special-situation events are present. The filing lacks any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situations catalyst. This is a standard current report with no actionable event for investors.
